major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown whenever you need a healing, damage, and crit boost; do not save it for a rainy day, as holding it just wastes uses, and note that Sanctified Wrath extends its duration to 30 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Crusader
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As the Avenging Crusader build, press it practically on cooldown since it is only a 1-minute cooldown; while active your Judgment is converted to healing, so keep Judgment rolling throughout the window.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use close to on cooldown with 2 or fewer Holy Power to avoid wastage; cast it on an ally to heal or on an enemy to deal damage, and do not sit on it since overhealing a single tick is better than banking the charge.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Prism
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: When talented over Divine Toll, use it close to on cooldown with 2 or fewer Holy Power, casting on an enemy for the most healing or on a friendly player when a specific target needs the burst.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Shock
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep Holy Shock on cooldown at all times to generate Holy Power and proc Infusion of Light; cast it on an enemy when you need damage or mana and on an ally when you need the heal.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Bulwark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As Lightsmith, press it on cooldown when you have 3 Holy Power (or 2 or fewer to avoid overcapping), prioritizing squishy targets or yourself so Solidarity's extra Bulwark lands on a tank.

major_cooldowns.name: Sacred Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As Lightsmith, cast it on yourself on cooldown when you need 3 Holy Power so the extra weapon goes to another healer.

major_cooldowns.name: Aura Mastery
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use proactively right before the group starts taking heavy damage since it is only a 9% reduction on the global cooldown; with Ringing of the Heavens talented, use it just after damage starts to get value from the free Divine Toll.

rules.description: Never cap Holy Power; always spend at 5
rules.action: Never cast a Holy Power generator while already at 5 Holy Power; spend with Light of Dawn, Word of Glory, or Eternal Flame first so you never waste generation, since your spenders are your most efficient spells.
Press Holy Shock the moment it comes off its 30-second cooldown to maintain Holy Power generation and roll Infusion of Light procs; never let it sit idle.

rules.description: Do not sit on Divine Toll or Avenging Wrath
rules.action: Use Divine Toll and Avenging Wrath close to on cooldown rather than banking them for a rainy day; the more uses you fit into a fight, the more total throughput you gain.

rules.description: Spend Infusion of Light on Flash of Light
rules.action: Consume Infusion of Light procs on Flash of Light when anyone needs healing, or on Judgment when there is no good Flash target; with Moment of Compassion, direct those Flash of Lights at the Beacon of the Savior player.

rules.description: Use Divine Toll at low Holy Power
rules.action: Only fire Divine Toll or Holy Prism when you are at 2 or fewer Holy Power so the Holy Power it generates is not wasted by overcapping.

rules.description: Use Hand of Divinity instant Holy Lights
rules.action: After Avenging Wrath or Avenging Crusader with Hand of Divinity talented, make sure to spend your free instant Holy Lights within the 20-second window, but hold them slightly for moments you actually need the burst.
When you receive Innervate, ignore your normal priority and spam Holy Light, even overcapping Holy Power; this is your strongest tool to out-heal healing absorbs.

rules.description: Stay near yourself or Beacon targets for Mastery
rules.action: Position within 10 yards of yourself or your Beacon targets when possible to maximize Mastery: Lightbringer, but prioritize safety and line of sight to the most players over Mastery efficiency.
